title: C Programming, Data Structures, and Algorithms
summary: A cumulative five-course pathway from C memory fundamentals through runtime analysis, linear and nonlinear data structures, sorting, graphs, greedy methods, backtracking, and dynamic programming.
pathwayRules: Use C for executable implementation and ZoeSkoul pseudocode for language-neutral algorithm reasoning.
Each course owns one cumulative workspace and every standard module ends with a progressive project.
The final capstone of each course is a single topic and reuses earlier workspace files.
The legacy c-data-structures assignment lab remains private and discoverable for existing assignments but is not a default new-enrollment course.

milestones.outcome: Build and test a cumulative record-management project.
Prove bounds and state all assumptions.
Maintain synchronized indexes without duplicate ownership.
Choose algorithms from constraints and justify time and space.
